sentences.en: We had hopes of developing tourism on a big scale.
sentences.zh: 我们希望大规模发展旅游业。

sentences.en: The tourism has provided much-needed economic help to this area.
sentences.zh: 旅游业为该地区提供了急需的经济援助。

sentences.en: Tourism will be a major source of revenue for Algeria.
sentences.zh: 旅游业将成为阿尔及利亚的主要收入来源。

senses.zh: 旅游，观光；旅游业，观光业
